$comment: What a blog image must be to publish. Read by src/lib/blog-images.ts (the build's check, which also validates this file), by scripts/blog-images.sh (the fixer: maxWidth, jpegQuality and the extensions to look for; it strips all metadata) and, copied by `make sync-renderer` (scripts/build-blog-renderer.mjs), by Kakiaji, which re-encodes the images of a text it posts and checks them against these rules. When the extensions change, also change the image glob in src/pages/blog/[id].astro (import.meta.glob takes only literals) and the per-format handling in scripts/blog-images.sh.
